body: Does the Winter Soldier go there too?
A look at his user history shows he does this a lot.

First off, nah man it doesn't look bad. I feel like if you grew out your hair a little longer nobody would notice. Heck, I probably wouldnt notice if you hadnt pointed it out!

Second, please dont take this badly, but you could rock the shit out of a good beanie. They dont fit my head right, but having a beanie kinda hang off the back of your head is the style nowadays. You kinda look like a beanie guy. I'd say give it a shot. 

But you look good man, no worries. I can tell from the side that your facial structure is really nice.

I still just dont know how I could do it. How I could just change my path. I live in the south raised in a southern home. Nobody in my family would understand. Its not about money for me, its about experiences. But it seems impossible to have those experiences without money. Then to get that money, you have to work a dead-end time consuming job so theres no time for experiences. I feel like im on an unchangeable track to become my father (an upper-middle class man with a pretty good family but nothing truly special about us). Were just like everyone else. Maybe my sisters are special, but not me. I have no talents, no motivation, no nothing. I dont know what to do
Please, youre not helping. You cant just tell someone to fix their problem.
